The basic amenities were missing, and we found the place to be quite unhealthy. The hotel has acquired another building across the road and pushed people there showing catchy but untrue photographs. The environment is dirty. You need to cross the road to go for breakfast, which is difficult in the rainy season. And more importantly, the rooms were inhabitable. More than the hotel, Agoda is to be blamed here. I called Agoda for a solution. They were blunt enough to disregard their responsibility. I have read on few forums to avoid Agoda as other travelers have similar experience with Agoda. I am just another person to join that group.
